ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across ~85% of visible area, with high-intensity (white) localized zones at distal margins (~15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches located at lateral distal tips; left lobe patch is irregular and covers distal 15% of surface area; right lobe patch is narrow, concentrated along the leading edge of the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 60 degrees; depth extends significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with multiple localized peaks; prominent macro-indentation (valley) visible at the mid-point of the right lobe trailing edge; finer micro-serrations along left lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along leading edges tapering to acute points at the lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on dark background) located at the extreme distal leading edge of the left lobe tip; scattered punctate white spots present across central dark regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent diagonal high-intensity linear segment (scratch) located on the upper-medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized structural irregularities and potential tissue loss at the distal margins of the trailing edge, specifically a deep notch on the right lobe.
